title: Subgaussian bound for a centered Bernoulli coordinate
statement: Let $p$ be a nonnegative real number with $p\leq 1$, let $k$ be a natural number, and choose a coordinate $i$ among $k$ independent Boolean coordinates, each equal to true with probability $p$. Under their product distribution, the coordinate indicator minus $p$ has a subgaussian moment generating function with variance proxy $(1/2)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative real parameter p with p at most 1.
A natural number k of coordinates.
A chosen coordinate i among the k coordinates.
The product distribution of independent Bernoulli(p) Boolean coordinates.
